---
title: "Lab Data and Offline Setup"
---

All lab inputs are stored in this repository. No lab downloads data or installs
packages when it runs. Prepare R and its packages once, then work offline.

[All lab data (ZIP)](downloads/all-lab-data.zip){download="all-lab-data.zip"} · [Data manifest](data/manifest.json) · [Offline setup](offline-setup.md)

## Run a complete lab

Extract its complete ZIP and keep the `data/` folder beside the `.qmd` and `.ipynb`.
Select the R kernel in Jupyter and run cells in order, or render the Quarto file.
Individual documents also work with the all-data ZIP extracted into the same directory.
The data loader verifies SHA-256 hashes and fails on missing or changed files;
it never falls back to an internet download.

Software installation is separate. Install the packages listed in the lab's setup
cell plus `digest`, `jsonlite`, `IRkernel`, `knitr` and `rmarkdown` before going offline.
See the [DiD environment](difference-in-differences-reproducibility.qmd) and
[RDD environment](regression-discontinuity-reproducibility.qmd) for tested locks.

## Datasets

RDS snapshots preserve R types, factor levels and time-series metadata. The
manifest records variables, missing values, source revisions and checksums.
Original package documentation and license notices are retained alongside the files.
Do not interchange the MatchIt LaLonde sample with the NSW/CPS benchmark samples.
